title: Markup in a message
lead: A translation may carry markup, and <i18n.T> renders it as elements Svelte creates, from an allowlist, with no @html anywhere.

payload.title: A payload is text
payload.label: Your name
payload.note: What you type is escaped before the parser sees it, so a tag in it renders as the characters it is.

component.title: A tag as a component
component.note: This usage maps the message's a onto a component of the app's, which takes the tag's attributes as props and its content as children.

blocks.title: Block elements where they fit
blocks.text:
• Off by default, since a message often sits inside a p or a button, which cannot hold a list.
  • Enabled per usage with BLOCK_ELEMENTS, here inside a div.

blocked.title: What never renders
blocked.text: This link has no address, and the image that followed it is gone.
blocked.note: Both are reported through onReport: in the server's log, and in the browser's console.

string.title: t() stays text
string.text: t() returns the same message with its markup as text, which is what a title or an attribute needs:
